sources.entry: SkyFonts - The simplest way to try, install, and manage fonts.

summary.name: SkyFonts
summary.one_liner: SkyFonts is a font try-out, install, and management tool from Monotype, listed on this page as a Mac app, though the page itself is mainly a Monotype enterprise font-services landing page.
use_cases: try and install fonts on a Mac
manage a shared font library for a team
search for fonts by mood or style
license fonts for web, print, or apps
govern font usage across an organization
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Monotype's font offering for organizations: a library of over 400,000 fonts searchable by mood, genre, use case, and style, plus tools to centralize a font library, control usage across teams, and license and publish fonts for web, print, apps, and campaigns. It lists several products, including Monotype Connect (activation, compliance, Adobe integration, risk visibility), Monotype Fonts (discovery and digital delivery), MyFonts (a marketplace for browsing, testing, and licensing), and Creative Type Services (custom typography design). The page's listing in awesome-mac describes SkyFonts as a way to try, install, and manage fonts, but the page text itself does not mention SkyFonts features. Most of the content is marketing claims and customer testimonials.
notable: Library of over 400,000 fonts searchable by mood, genre, use case, and style
Monotype Connect for font activation, licensing compliance, and Adobe integration
Custom type design and typography consultation services
caveats: Page text does not mention SkyFonts itself; the Mac and SkyFonts details come from the awesome-mac listing
Pricing and subscription terms are not stated on the page
Much of the page is enterprise marketing and testimonials
